label: Strict-ground map for nonmutual existential dependence: content, sense and rivals
summary: Repair after the PR #1600 semantic challenge. (1) The map's Lean type is a structural surrogate: S and the labelling are arbitrary and PLG atoms are uninterpreted, so the type encodes only that distinct-step D embeds into the strict order of a consistent PLG theory. Reading the labels as existence facts and the edges as faithful grounding is an OPEN interpretation outside the type. (2) Verified strength: consistency plus the map force distinct-step D to have no finite cycle (mapForcesDistinctDependenceAcyclic), which is strictly more than nonmutuality. So the map's warrant is a warrant for acyclicity. Well-foundedness for finite Atom and the converse embedding are not verified or relied on. (3) Sense: disambiguation 23dd6f32 gives D sense 1 (DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING, efficient-causal) and 'ground' sense 2 (formal uninterpreted strict partial ground), bridged only by the OPEN map. The constitutive/metaphysical reading of the atoms does not cover D's own paradigm edge (sun/light), so it would need a restricted non-causal receives-esse relation. On the natural/causal reading the warrant reduces to efficient-causal asymmetry strengthened to acyclicity. (4) Rivals to the map: modal co-existence; symmetric metaphysical dependence (Barnes 2018, Thompson 2016; challenger-cited, attribution deferred); vacuous counterpossibles. On the last, any two distinct necessary beings mutually D-depend, so the map plus consistency allows at most one necessary being in B. The map therefore depends on a non-vacuist semantics for D or a domain restriction, which DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING leaves unspecified. (5) Nonvacuity: a joint Nat model with a nonempty D is verified. No substantive objection to the formal validity was identified. 2026-11-24 consumer test: 40b8313e already supplies the exact P2 of 972ed7e5. Result a01e0429 extends the consistent successor sequents to all x < y, interprets cause and per se link by c = x+1, and realizes the entire P2 consumer and its priority continuation on that series. Every f has a cause f+1. The Second Way's other premises hold together while its regress prohibition fails. This is a populated interpretation, with one respect and uninterpreted labels. It leaves P8's all-respects warrant and the metaphysical map open. The 2026-11-25 representation test resolves the earlier converse for identity labels on an inhabited bearer type. Under distinct-step acyclicity these generating sequents yield exactly the reversed nonempty paths as strict partial grounds. For a fixed labelling into a populated atom type, it is acyclicity of the projected steps that characterizes existence of a consistent theory. Two disjoint paths can project to a two-cycle even when their own endpoint labels differ. Direct acyclicity gives P2. With the same strict map, per se link alignment and finitely many ancestral labels for each effect give the Second Way regress premise even on an infinite bearer domain.
blocker: The map's interpretation is unresolved. Next tests: (a) type a restricted non-causal receives-esse relation with its own definition and Lean declaration, and test the map on it; (b) type a causal ordering of existence facts and compare its warrant with STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-NOT-DEPENDENT-ON-EFFECT; (c) fix whether D's counterpossibles are vacuist or non-vacuist (related to #1593); (d) assess the Barnes/Thompson symmetric-dependence cases after reading the texts. For the infinite-series comparison the remaining discriminant is actual supply: on one sustaining interpretation, what explains occupation of the entire series? The arithmetic relations carry no supply/absence alternatives. See docs/notes/distinct-dependence-strict-ground-route.md, ‘The infinite series at the efficient-cause consumer’. The finite-label test now asks for a reason why one effect has only finitely many independently identified existential fact levels and why every sustaining link changes level in the required direction.

current_assessment.scope: The distinct-step map into strict PLG, its exact representational strength, and local finite-label support for per se accessibility.
current_assessment.assessment: For acyclic distinct-step dependence on a populated domain, identity labels and the edge theory reproduce its reversed nonempty finite paths exactly. Independent identification of fact levels can add information. A consistent PLG theory, a map taking every distinct dependence step to strict ground in that theory, alignment of every per se cause with such a step, and finitely many of those labels in each effect’s ancestry suffice for accessibility. Independently tracing ordinary supply gives local direction. A finite inventory covering unrestricted existential ancestry remains unwarranted by those examples.
current_assessment.next_test: For one effect, justify an inventory of existential roles that covers every upstream supplier, and test the orientation on independently identified transitions and repeated roles.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge at ab774b58c accepted the populated-domain, acyclic identity result, the fixed-label criterion and collision control, and all four premises of the regress argument. Five registered results passed binding, Comparator and NanoDa. The reviewed outcome is published on research/comparing-explanatory-representations.
current_assessment.supersedes: The earlier status of the converse as proposed and of the finite-atom pullback as unchecked. The philosophical warrant for the selected interpretation remains open.
